attempts.text:
**The window starts on the anchor.** Column 0 is the spine, `ymgI`, carried by 100% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 1% of calls; the model names it in 96% of calls at 0.32 bits. Then columns 1 to 79 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 1 to 89% of calls.

**The first forks are hesitant.** Column 3, `ymgF`, is the most hesitant of the window at 1.70 bits and the fewest named, 60%, in a region of plasticity in 89% of calls; column 4, `pdeG`, follows at 0.94 bits and 89%. A second branch of 10 families runs through columns 1 to 10, from `ymgJ` to `ycgN`, carried by 10 to 11% of chromosomes, and another of 8 families through columns 12 to 19, `umuD` to `dadX`, at 11%.

**Long stretches of forks follow.** A branch of 14 families runs through columns 32 to 45, `ychF` to `ldrB`, at 11%, and another of 14 through columns 48 to 61, `chaA` to `ychJ`, at 11%. The `pot` genes, [[spermidine and putrescine transport]], sit at columns 25 to 28, and the `lol` genes, [[lipoprotein release]], at columns 33 to 35.

**The window ends in the `flg` genes.** `flgL` to `flgM`, columns 67 to 79, [[flagellar basal body assembly]], carried by 40 to 59% of chromosomes. The model names 90% of genes over the window at 0.50 bits; inside a region of plasticity it names 76% against 97% outside, and hesitates 1.25 against 0.15 bits.

label: ymgI
facts:
WINDOW: the ymgI window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor ymgI, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,528 to 2,607 from dnaA. Read in 522 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying ymgI once); 41,760 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 90% of genes, 0.50 bits on average (perplexity 1.6 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 27,265 calls, named 98%, 0.13 bits; shell 13,930 calls, named 78%, 1.09 bits; cloud 565 calls, named 19%, 3.86 bits. Outside an RGP 28,249 calls, named 97%, 0.15 bits; inside an RGP 13,511 calls, named 76%, 1.25 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 70 fork, 9 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.25 against 0.15 bits) and names fewer genes (76% against 97%); 13,511 of the 41,760 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 3 (ymgF) 1.70 bits, RGP 89%; column 13 ("protein YmgK") 1.00 bits, RGP 80%; column 4 (pdeG) 0.94 bits, RGP 89%. The 13 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 88%, 0.77 bits on average; the other 67 columns: named 90%, 0.45 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 1-89%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 1%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 1%. Genes: ymgI. named 96%; 0.32 bits.
2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 1-89%. named 60-98% (mean 90%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 3, named 60%, 1.70 bits.
   a second branch of 10 families through columns 1-10, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10-11%, 9 P, 1 S; the branch's families: ymgJ, "ATPase", minE, minD, minC, ycgJ, pliG, "YcgL domain-containing protein", ycgM, ycgN
